contributions.title: Adaptive Multiscale Singular Packet Decomposition (AM-SPD) 1.0.0

contributions.boundary: Exact mode reconstructs normalized floating-point array coordinates up to roundoff; previews are quantized. The downstream scalar parameter budget excludes geometry-core cost and is not a bit-rate or global optimality guarantee. Replay validates archived singular/Lagrange/exact reopening coordinates against fresh seed spans, projected reconstructions and scalar costs, then freshly computes replacements/refits/final selection; it does not repeat geometry discovery. The declared hosted CI matrix and strict release gates passed at bcfe61c0e46470d54abc829fa6d4324886333436; native Windows offline qualification and private stable publication completed. These are bounded finite numerical checks, not universal or bitwise cross-platform claims.
contributions.fresh_replay_scope: 240 Linux package tests, 20 integration checks, lint, compilation and source manifest. Clean offline installed-wheel qualification passed all four strict archived-seed replay cases and 20 integration checks outside the checkout. Independent offline source-distribution qualification passed 240 extracted tests without skips, 20 integration checks, dependency checks and strict geometry replay, with the archive unchanged. Earlier 228/232-test receipts remain preserved as earlier evidence; refreshed Windows static preflight covers four schema-2 fixtures and 12 archived seed coordinate sets.
